settings.headline: Patients and visitors
settings.subtitle: Hours, parking, what to bring, billing questions and how to prepare for a visit.

settings.headline: Three things that help
settings.intro: Most visits go more smoothly when you have these ready.

items.title: Photo ID and insurance card
items.text: Bring both to registration. If you are uninsured, ask about financial assistance at the cashier desk.

items.title: A list of medications
items.text: Include doses and allergies. Your phone's photo of bottles is fine.

items.title: A support person if you need one
items.text: Visitor guidelines vary by unit. Check the visitor guide before you come.
